front.transcription:
ESCALATION
1. INCREASE THREAT
Advance the Threat Level marker 1 space.
2. ADD AGENTS
Draw the bottom card from the Threat deck and add 3 agents to that city. Discard the card to the Threat discard pile.
3. INTENSIFY
Shuffle the cards in the Threat discard pile and put them on top of the Threat deck.
